desc.p: Maps RxNorm concepts to SNOMED CT medicinal products. The source codes are those emitted by the SYNDERAI Synthea pipeline; they cannot be corrected upstream and a number of them are not valid RxNorm identifiers. Every such code is nevertheless mapped, so that the synthetic data always carries a SNOMED CT code, and every affected row opens its comment with CAVE: RXCUI is not valid, for synthetic consistency mapped based on display name. Three relationship values are used. equivalent means the target denotes what the source display name describes. wider means the target is a broader SNOMED CT concept, chosen because SNOMED CT has no clinical drug at that strength or in that dose form: the mapping then drops the strength, and where the dose form does not fit either, the dose form as well. unmatched means SNOMED CT has no usable concept at all. 390 rows in total: 365 equivalent, 24 wider, 1 unmatched.
